senses.gloss: to invite; to appoint; to summon; to prepare.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 3:5">Targ. Mic. III, 5</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 19:10">Targ. Ex. XIX, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 19:14">14</cite> (ed. Berl. <he>זָמֵין</he>, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 25); a. fr. [Ib. XXV, 22 <he>ואִיזַמָן</he>, ed. Berl. <he>ואֵיזָמֵין</he>, Y. <he>אֵיזְמַן</he>, Ithpe.].—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:3">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מְזַמְּנִינָן ליה וכ׳</he> we summon him &c.
Cant. R. to V, 13 ביומוי דזַמְּנִינָן וכ׳ (not דזמניין) in those my days when we invited two parties of scholars (for discussions).—Part. pass. מְזַמַּן (hebraism: מְזוּמָּן).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 72:17">Targ. Ps. LXXII, 17</cite> (h. text <he>ינון</he>).—Pl. constr. <he>מְזַמְּנֵי</he>.

senses.gloss: to appoint a meal in common, to say grace in common.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 45b:19">Ber. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>ניהדר ונְזַמֵּן</he> let us go back and agree (retrospectively) to make our meal a common one.
